title: Act No. 3 of 2024 – Education and Training (Amendment) Act, 2024
text:
Education and Training
BELIZE:
EDUCATION AND TRAINING (AMENDMENT) ACT, 2024
ARRANGEMENT OF SECTIONS
1. Short title.
2. Amendment of section 2.
3. Amendment of section 59.

No. 3] Education and Training 19
No. 3 of 2024
I assent,
(H.E. DAME FROYLA TZALAM)
Governor-General
21st February, 2024.
AN ACT to amend the Education and Training Act,
Chapter 36:01 of the Substantive Laws of Belize,
Revised Edition 2020; to increase the age of compulsory
education for a child; and to provide for matters
connected therewith or incidental thereto.
(Gazetted 24th February, 2024)
BE IT ENACTED, by and with the advice and consent of
the House of Representatives and Senate of Belize and
by the authority of the same, as follows:
1. This Act may be cited as the Short title.
EDUCATION AND TRAINING
(AMENDMENT) ACT, 2024,

20 Education and Training [No. 3
CAP. 36:01. and shall be read and construed as one with the Education
and Training Act, which is hereinafter referred to as the
principal Act.
Amendment of 2. Section 2 of the principal Act is amended by repealing
section 2.
the definition of “child of compulsory school age” and
substituting the following–
“means a child who is not less than 5 years of age but not
more than sixteen years of age;”.
Amendment of 3. Section 59 of the principal Act is amended by deleting
section 59.
the word “fourteen” wherever it occurs and substituting the
word “sixteen”.
